description: Géométrie des Unités foncières du département des Alpes-Maritimes - 2016 is a dataset listed in Geocatalogue France, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by crige-paca.org. Geometry of the land units of the Alpes-Maritimes on 01/01/2016 (excluding municipalities not covered by the PCI). Coverage: FR. The portal shows the English title as "Geometry of the Land Units of the Alpes-Maritimes department - 2016" (machine-translated by the portal). Its keywords include Cadastre, Unité foncière, Propriété foncière. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support transport network, traffic and access studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-geocatalogue-fr.
